profile.en: They are a girl who manifested abilities through the US forces' special skill development program. They have been part of the US forces since childhood, receiving soldier training, but one day participated in a classified mission experiment and manifested the Aqua Mistress power, which lets them infiltrate their own blood into liquid and control it as if it were part of their body. Since then they have joined a team that fights in the underworld. They are cool and rarely get passionate; especially during missions they are loyal to orders and carry out tasks without showing emotion. They leave moral judgment to the military, suppressing feelings even on cruel missions, though they have begun to harbor slight doubts about tactics that even attack civilian homes and children. text.ja: レティシア・ベルメールだ。……言いたいことはわかるが口に出すな。こ、これは任務のために必要な衣装なんだっ
text.en: I'm Leticia Belmail... I understand what you want to say, but don't say it out loud. Th-this is a costume necessary for the mission.

text.ja: 任務のためとはいえ……こんな格好をさせられるとは……。それになぜ私がプールなんかに……っ。この装備ではほとんど戦えない……

text.ja: 黙れ……っ。そしてじろじろ見るな！　この水着しか用意されてなかったんだ！

text.ja: くうぅ……！　やはり周りから視線が……っ。潜入捜査とはいえ、これではミスを誘発しかねないというのに……！
